title: NASA-UAP-D016, Preliminary Gemini 4 Crew Debriefing, Part I, 1965
what_is_it: A preliminary crew debriefing transcript from the Gemini 4 spaceflight, recorded aboard the recovery ship USS Wasp on June 9, 1965.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text is available — all facts are derived from metadata and the CSV description only.

This is a single-source account from one crew member's debriefing.
